publishedMetadata.title: Mutations and invalidation
publishedMetadata.description: An applied TanStack Query 5 module on mutations and invalidation, integrating real HTTP, cache state, failure recovery, and separate instructor/browser acceptance.
objectives: Use useMutation for writes, attach one logical idempotency key, and invalidate all affected query views after confirmed success.
Create with a valid key; verify one 201, then a GET refreshes the matching list. A 422 must never produce an invalidation-based success state.
A retry that regenerates the idempotency key may produce duplicate tasks. Avoid retrying unauthorized or validation failures automatically.
